status: Declared before running this secondary analysis.
timing: After human confirmation retrieval scores were observed. This is a post-confirmation mechanism analysis.
purpose: Measure certificate behavior and prefix work under every already-prespecified ranking variant.
selection: All six pilot ranking variants. No ranking is selected from confirmation outcomes.
inputs: Frozen extracted claims and their explicit succession pairs
cohort: Every query whose visible date window parses, identically across all six rankings.
metrics: Stable contexts among all parsed queries
Stable contexts among each ranking's modeled contexts
Stability on the fixed title_residual modeled-context cohort
Stability on the fixed union of modeled-context cohorts
efficiency: Support-check counts and examined candidates only; this analysis does not estimate end-to-end latency.
control: An optimized shared-order implementation must match all six frozen ranking APIs exactly on all 176 pilot questions before confirmation analysis.
main_experiment: The selected title_residual ranking and primary reader protocol stay frozen. This analysis does not change any main result.
